tools.name: execute_tool_script
tools.description:
Execute a Starlark script that orchestrates multiple tool calls and returns an aggregated result. Use 'return' to produce output.

Available tools (callable as functions with keyword or positional arguments):
  - probe_lookup: Look up a record by id. Returns {id, value}.

Use call_tool("name", ...) to call any tool by its original name.

Built-in: parallel([fn1, fn2, ...]) executes zero-arg callables concurrently and returns results in order. Use with lambda to fan out tool calls. If a callable errors, the whole script fails, but sibling callables still run to completion first (no early cancellation).

Named data arguments passed in the 'data' parameter are available as top-level variables.

data.description: Optional named values injected as top-level variables in the script.

script.description: A Starlark script. Call any listed tool as a function, use loops/conditionals, fan out with parallel(), and use 'return' to produce output.
examples:
# 'deps' is supplied via the data argument below. Bind the loop variable with a
# default arg (d=d) so each lambda captures its own value rather than the last one.
results = parallel([
    lambda d=d: osv_query_vulnerability(package=d["name"], version=d["version"])
    for d in deps
])
vulnerable = [r for r in results if r.get("vulns")]
return {"checked": len(results), "vulnerable": vulnerable}
